answer: Perfect! All 126 tests are now passing. The issue was a boundary condition bug in the `bulk_discount` function. The condition was using `>` (greater than) instead of `>=` (greater than or equal to), so the 10% discount wasn't being applied when the quantity was exactly at the threshold of 10 units. The docstring already correctly stated the discount applies "when buying BULK_THRESHOLD units or more", so the fix aligns the code with its intended behavior.
